run_challenge_evaluation: run the NeurIPS challenge evaluation script with a results file and model name to compute success rate
compute_valid_ml_success: compute validated ML success rates by comparing ML predicted energies against DFT ground truth energies
process_ml_data: process ML prediction results from an NPZ file and organize energies by system and config ID
get_dft_data: organize released DFT target mapping into a nested dictionary for evaluation lookup by system and config
is_successful: check if a predicted ML energy is within the success threshold of the best DFT energy
